method: Shipped fit (every L1 line at its J2000 period) vs the same fitter with the p-carrying lines (obliquity p+s_i, climatic precession p+g_i) evaluated on the composed lunisolar clock of date: each such line on its own warped time τ = t + Δ(t)·P, Δ(t) the extra precession cycles since J2000; eccentricity lines and the climate-internal harmonics unwarped.

controls.warp_scale_scan: ΔR² total against the shipped fit with the warp scaled by k over [-1.0, 6.0] step 0.1 (k = 1 the model's clock, k = −1 the counter-rotating sign); best k per window
controls.halves: ΔR² total at k = 1 on each half of the window, fitted independently
controls.dp_scan: ΔR² total against the shipped fit with a constant frequency offset δp (″/yr) on the p-lines over [-0.3, 0.6] step 0.02 at k = 0; the preferred δp, the implied p, and the clock's gain (k = 1) on top of it
controls.dp_scan_by_family: the same δp scan on one family at a time (obliquity lines only; climatic-precession lines only), the other family at its shipped periods
